entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: the reward is $35 off. To unlock your code, you need to say at least 1,200 words on this call: the "Your words" bar at the bottom of your screen counts them. You can stop whenever you like, but it only unlocks once you reach that. What brings you to Replogle Globes today?
